descriptions.zh: 本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en: The queries per second (QPS) limit for this API is 10 per user. If you exceed this limit, your API calls will be throttled. This may impact your business. To avoid service disruption, call the API at a reasonable rate.
